correction: For every paired model comparison, reconstruct the heldout peer-relative target and both predictions after intersecting the exact available worker records. Matching error rows alone is insufficient when models have different missingness and thus different evaluation peers.
why_primary_unaffected: FE and joint20 have identical nonmissing evaluation sets. All pooled continuous comparisons share this support.
randomness_revision: Bootstrap seeds are keyed by fixed model-pair and difficulty identity, preventing added candidate models from changing Monte Carlo draws for an existing contrast.
researcher_note: This is an implementation correctness fix, not post-outcome model selection. Individual prediction rows retain model-specific observable support; infer model differences from the paired common-peer table.
